results.title: Reflected Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) in Search Query Parameter
results.description: The search functionality at /search reflects the 'q' URL parameter directly into the DOM without sanitization or contextual HTML entity encoding.
results.steps_to_reproduce:
1. Launch agent-browser and navigate to: https://target.local/search?q=test
2. Submit input containing HTML tags.
3. Verify unencoded reflection in DOM snapshot.
results.impact: Enables an attacker to hijack active user sessions, steal authentication cookies, or execute malicious JavaScript in the victim's session.

cwe.name: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')

results.title: Overly Permissive Cross-Origin Resource Sharing (CORS) Policy
results.description: The API endpoint reflects arbitrary Origin request headers with 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin: <origin>' and sets 'Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true', permitting cross-origin credentialed access.
results.steps_to_reproduce:
1. Intercept network request to https://target.local/api/v1/user/profile.
2. Replay request with header 'Origin: https://evil.com'.
3. Observe response header 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin: https://evil.com' and 'Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true'.
results.impact: Malicious third-party websites can issue authenticated requests to read confidential user profile data and tokens.

cwe.name: Permissive Cross-domain Policy with Untrusted Domains
